Certainly! There are several popular and reputable gambling websites where you can bet on sports events. They also provide a compelling loyalty program and often run promotional offers.  Like Bet365, they're a major player in regulated markets.

Finally, consider FanDuel.  Similar to DraftKings in its origins, FanDuel provides an excellent betting experience, particularly for those new to sports wagering. They feature a clean, easy-to-navigate platform, quick payouts, and a focus on responsible gambling resources.  They also operate legally within established regulatory frameworks.

Before engaging with any of these platforms, it's crucial to understand the laws surrounding online gambling in your specific location and to gamble responsibly. Each platform provides tools and resources to help users manage their betting habits.
